progress: Do you have my materials, $N?
completion: Ah, yes. Just what I needed! I'll make a special concoction with this. The silithid won't like it one bit!

8809.name: Extraordinary Materials
desc: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
details: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
progress: You have something for me, $N ?
completion: Ah, yes. These materials are of excellent quality. Thank you, $N .

8833.name: Ten Commendation Signets
progress: I accept commendation signets from adventurers who have received them in the line of duty.  For each set of ten that you hand to me, I'll make sure that you receive a significant acknowledgement of your deeds with Undercity.  I also accept single tokens, but at a much reduced rate of recognition.  We are much more interested in greater feats of duty, though no feat will be ignored.$B$BWith that said, I'll gladly take your signets if you are ready to hand in a set.
completion: Excellent! It is no small sacrifice that you've made to earn these signets, and you will be acknowledged for your service appropriately. It's adventurers like you, $N, that truly make a difference.$B$BLet me know if you have additional signets to hand in; I'll gladly help you out with whatever ones you need exchanged.

8857.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Ashi
desc: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.$B
details: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
completion: Oh the chickens I will craft from this wondrous husk! Well done, my $gboy:girl; !
progress: Yes? What have you got there?

8881.name: Large Cluster Rockets
progress: Large cluster rockets require vast resources and skill to create, but their brilliance and beauty is worth that effort!  Bring me coins of ancestry and I will grant you the knowledge of their crafting.
completion: Thank you, $N. Here is the recipe for large cluster rockets. May your products bring joy and luck to all those who gaze up them.

8905.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Wildheart Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
If you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.
progress: Have you brought me what I requested of you, $N?

8929.name: In Search of Anthion
desc: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
objectives: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
details: Well, nothing left for us to do but try out the goblin's invention. Word has it that Anthion was mowed down by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.
Try using the device there and find out whatever Anthion knew.
completion: Deliana had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.

8953.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
Well, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.
progress: You're back, $N. You must tell me all about what you've found out. But first let us arrange for your reward.

8977.name: Return to Deliana
desc: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: It's been great working with you, $N. Here is the finished product.
I hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
completion: Excellent! You've done well, $N. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.
progress: You've returned?

9001.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
objectives: Give Deliana your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
I hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.
progress: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Magister's pieces in exchange for your new Sorcerer's Crown and Robes?

9025.name: Morgan's Discovery
desc: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
objectives: Return to Aristan Mottar outside the bank in Stormwind's Trade District.
details: Well, I'll be. It looks like Aristan might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in love potions and insidious mind-altering draughts.
It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of them, but a few of the ingredients I detected... Smells funny.
completion: While I thought this would be the case, finding out that my suspicions were correct is still unsettling. We must carefully consider our next move.
Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.

9049.name: Redemption Girdle
desc: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.
objectives: Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Redemption Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.
details: You will find the remnants of our fallen heroes on the corpses of the Lords of Naxxramas. Bring those desecrated keepsakes to me along with wartorn plate scraps and crafting materials capable of revitalizing the cursed armor and I shall craft a fine piece of armor for you.
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !$B , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Redemption Girdle.

9073.name: Earthshatter Handguards
desc: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
objectives: Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Handguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Handguards, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
details: Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands?$B$BThe armor has been desecrated and is undoubtedly being used for evil; however, with wartorn armor scraps, the desecrated armor can be renewed and worn for battle once more.$B$BBring me the remnants of the fallen along with purification materials and Earthshatter shall be yours to don.$B$BSearch Naxxramas.
progress: Have you brought me that which I require?
completion: These handguards channel the power of the elements!

9097.name: Frostfire Circlet
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Frostfire Circlet if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Frostfire Circlet if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.
details: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire.$B$B<Angela points to her head.>$B$BIt's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
progress: You got some missing parts for the quest please go and get them all!
completion: Exellent $N !,$Byou got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Frostfire Circlet.

9121.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Arcane Crystals, 2 Nexus Crystals, 1 Righteous Orb and 60 gold pieces. You must also be Honored with the Argent Dawn.$B
details: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

We have devised a way to gain entry via arcane cloaking - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is somewhat lacking, $N, the price will be high. You may decline and choose to return when you are revered or exalted for a discount.
completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.
progress: None have entered Naxxramas and lived to tell the tale.

9241.name: Polar Bracers
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 4 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold. $B
details: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create Polar bracers. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!
progress: Have you brought the materials?

9265.name: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
desc: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
objectives: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
details: The Lich King has sent his undead upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend the Undercity from these accursed invaders? $B $BThere are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!
completion: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... they must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.
progress: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!

9337.name: Major Mana Potion
progress: In addition to our other supplies, we also have a number of major mana potions you may find useful. I will give you one in exchange for fifteen necrotic runes.
completion: Here you are, $N. Be careful out there. Our numbers are not so large we can afford many battlefield casualties.

65593.name: Hearts of the Lovers
details: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure. $B My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally. $B In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet. $B They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
progress: Ah, $N , you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
completion: As expected. Excellently done, $N . $B Idiots.

78145.name: Arcanic Systems Manual
progress:
Have you brought something to add to our collection?
Arcanic Systems Manual ( 1 )
completion: Thank you, $N . Our knowledge expands through your efforts. $B If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.

91777.name: Rare Books
objectives: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

91921.name: Return to Quinn (Again)
objectives: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
*Quinn's Potion (provided)
details: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.
Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
progress: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.

92401.name: A Frightened Request
objectives: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
*Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
details: It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.
There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
progress: First my son and now sweet Edward...

92473.name: Aggressive Encroachment
objectives: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.
* Scrawny Ursera Claw (6)
details: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
progress: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?

94321.name: Craftsman's Writ: Flask of Chromatic Resistance [Artisan]

94441.name: A Lesson in Divinity
objectives: Speak with Danitha Morr in the keep at Tyr's Watch.
details: Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.
You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, .

94489.name: The Wounds of Betrayal
objectives: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.

94897.name: The Fate of a Loved One
objectives: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

95041.name: Data Hoarders
objectives: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

95161.name: Remember That I Love You
objectives: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
* Blood-Stained Letter (provided)
details: If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.
If you see little Jeremy, do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
progress: Yes? What do you need?

95809.name: Heartwoven
objectives: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
*Reed-woven Heart (provided)
details: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.
Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.
Thank you.
progress: I'm more than worried about him!

97225.name: Forgotten Loa Idols
objectives: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
*Forgotten Loa Idol (8)
details: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.
The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.
This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.
Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
progress: Have you found our loa idols, <name>? We must begin our rituals again soon.
desc: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe. ...

97249.name: Favorite Food
objectives: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
*Migi's Lunch (provided)
details: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.
Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
progress: I think we can win this one...

97969.name: Camping 101: Leatherworking
desc:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, class. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.
With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
objectives: Speak with Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
details:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, class. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.
With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

98209.name: Bloom of the Heavens
objectives:
Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.

98545.name: Leonid's Letter
details: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.
You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.
<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
objectives: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
*Sealed Letter (Forever) (provided)
completion: Thanks for delivering this, pal.
Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
progress: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.

99049.name: Threat from Below
desc:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.
Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
